SAKUYA_WATCH.title: Sakuya's Pocket Watch
SAKUYA_WATCH.description:
[gold]Right-click this relic[/gold] to enter/exit [gold]Time Stop[/gold].
Count cap [blue]12[/blue]; at the start of each combat, restore the count to cap. Each time you play [blue]1[/blue] card, or if you are in [gold]Time Stop[/gold] at the start of your turn, reduce the count by [blue]1[/blue]; when the count reaches 0, immediately exit [gold]Time Stop[/gold] and end your turn.
SAKUYA_WATCH.flavor: A pocket watch carried by Sakuya Izayoi, one of the tools she uses to activate time stop.
SAKUYA_LUNA_DIAL.title: Luna Dial
SAKUYA_LUNA_DIAL.description:
[gold]Right-click this relic[/gold] to enter/exit [gold]Time Stop[/gold].
Count cap [blue]12[/blue]; at the start of each turn, restore the count to cap. Each time you play [blue]1[/blue] card, or if you are in [gold]Time Stop[/gold] at the start of your turn, reduce the count by [blue]1[/blue]; when the count reaches 0, immediately exit [gold]Time Stop[/gold] and end your turn.
SAKUYA_LUNA_DIAL.flavor: Although activating time stop doesn't necessarily require a tool, Sakuya still likes to use it to activate time stop.
TH_SAKUYA-MAID_CLOTH.title: Maid Uniform
TH_SAKUYA-MAID_CLOTH.description: On the first turn of each combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all cards you draw.
TH_SAKUYA-MAID_CLOTH.flavor: A brand new maid uniform, looks like it fits your size.
TH_SAKUYA-MAGIC_DECK.title: Magic Playing Cards
TH_SAKUYA-MAGIC_DECK.description: Whenever a shuffle is triggered, you may rearrange the order of cards in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] arbitrarily.
TH_SAKUYA-MAGIC_DECK.flavor: A deck of playing cards used for magic performances, prepared for various needed scenarios.
TH_SAKUYA-MAGIC_DECK.selectionScreenProm: Click to rearrange the order of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] (sorted by click order; unclicked cards keep original order).
TH_SAKUYA-DICE.title: Lead-filled dice
TH_SAKUYA-DICE.description: Your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] is now displayed in actual order.
TH_SAKUYA-DICE.flavor: A gambler's usual trick; they already know the result before the dice fall.
TH_SAKUYA-WHITE_CARD.title: Blank Card
TH_SAKUYA-WHITE_CARD.description: At the start of each combat, choose any [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold], copy it, and put it into your hand.
TH_SAKUYA-WHITE_CARD.flavor: A completely blank card, representing infinite possibilities.
TH_SAKUYA-CLOCK_WORK.title: Gear Spring
TH_SAKUYA-CLOCK_WORK.description: At the end of your turn, if you have remaining {Energy:energyIcons()}, increase your [gold]Time Stop[/gold] count by [blue]1[/blue].
TH_SAKUYA-CLOCK_WORK.flavor: It seems to have once been part of a larger clock; somehow it ended up here.
TH_SAKUYA-CLOCK_HAND.title: Etched Clock Hand
TH_SAKUYA-CLOCK_HAND.description: When your [gold]Time Stop[/gold] count decreases, there is a [blue]50%[/blue] chance it does not decrease.
TH_SAKUYA-CLOCK_HAND.flavor: Don't care how much time you have, care about how you use the time you have.
TH_SAKUYA-DOCTOR_LICENSE.title: Professional Surgeon's License
TH_SAKUYA-DOCTOR_LICENSE.description: Whenever you deal unblocked damage to an enemy, make it lose [blue]1[/blue] HP at the end of the turn.
TH_SAKUYA-DOCTOR_LICENSE.flavor: "How to Become the Best Healer as a Murderer" – I've already thought of the title for your next medical book.
TH_SAKUYA-HONOR.title: Supreme Criminal's Sense of Honor
TH_SAKUYA-HONOR.description:
Whenever a non-[gold]Minion[/gold] enemy dies, increase the count based on its type ([blue]Normal:3[/blue]/[red]Elite:6[/red]/[purple]Boss:9[/purple]).
[gold]Right-click this relic[/gold] to consume all count and heal equal HP; excess becomes Max HP.
TH_SAKUYA-HONOR.flavor: The craving for flesh comes not from your wicked soul, but from your blood.
TH_SAKUYA-BLOOD_PIPE.title: Scarlet Pipe
TH_SAKUYA-BLOOD_PIPE.description: When you defeat a [red]Elite[/red] enemy, you may [gold]Remove[/gold] a card from your [gold]deck[/gold].
TH_SAKUYA-BLOOD_PIPE.flavor: The murderer so needs to prove his existence through some special tactile sensation.
TH_SAKUYA-BLOOD_COAT.title: Scarlet Coat
TH_SAKUYA-BLOOD_COAT.description: Whenever you lose HP, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]1[/blue] extra card next turn.
TH_SAKUYA-BLOOD_COAT.flavor: Driven by an obsession ordinary people cannot hold, you have become a monster ordinary people cannot become. You no longer feel any fear at the sight of human misery.
TH_SAKUYA-DOG_SAKUYA.title: Dog Sakuya
TH_SAKUYA-DOG_SAKUYA.description: Upon pickup, add a [gold]Little Knife[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
TH_SAKUYA-DOG_SAKUYA.flavor: Standard three-head-tall, with large dog ears on both sides and a big ahoge on the head that sometimes twitches like an antenna.
TH_SAKUYA-REVERSE_WATCH.title: Reverse Watch
TH_SAKUYA-REVERSE_WATCH.description: [gold]Right-click this relic[/gold] to reset your state to the state at the start of this turn. Cooldown of [blue]1[/blue] turn. (HP, energy, draw/discard/hand, and status effects).
TH_SAKUYA-SCARLET_CAKE.title: Scarlet Devil Cake
TH_SAKUYA-SCARLET_CAKE.description:
Whenever you lose HP, gain that much [gold]Strength[/gold].
At the start of your turn, heal [blue]2[/blue] HP.
TH_SAKUYA-SCARLET_CAKE.flavor: A dreamy sweet made in the image of the Scarlet Devil's hat. When cut, a sweet sauce like blood flows out.
